ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white interior against 40% low-intensity black margins and central peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish/tan pigment discoloration patch on the superior interior edge of the right lobe's white area.
